name: Whitted-Style Shading with Diffuse/Glossy Materials
definition: Computes the color for a ray using a Whitted-style shading model for diffuse or glossy materials, including ambient lighting and direct illumination from lights.
summary: Whitted-style shading computes surface color by combining ambient lighting with direct illumination and shadow rays, differing from path tracing by limiting recursion and using analytical approximations for glossy reflections.
